function.name: get_url_content
function.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common tools you can use to book flights—whether you’re a traveler looking for a website or a developer looking for an API.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it’s good for | Typical use case |
|----------|----------------|--------------------|------------------|
| **Consumer‑facing booking sites** | **Expedia** | Wide selection of flights, hotels, car rentals | One‑stop travel planning |
| | **Kayak** | Price comparison across many airlines | Find the cheapest fare |
| | **Skyscanner** | Global flight search, price alerts | Compare prices by date or “cheapest month” |
| | **Google Flights** | Fast UI, price graph, flexible dates | Quick price trend checks |
| | **Momondo** | Aggressive price comparison, hidden‑city fares | Find the lowest price across many carriers |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price” and Express Deals | Last‑minute deals |
| | **Orbitz** | Loyalty program, bundled packages | Frequent traveler rewards |
| | **Travelocity** | Similar to Orbitz, often bundled with hotels | All‑in‑one booking |
| | **CheapOair** | Focus on low‑fare airlines | Budget travelers |
| | **Hotwire** | “Hot rate” deals, last‑minute bookings | Quick, low‑price options |
| | **Trip.com** | Strong presence in Asia, multi‑currency | International travelers |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** (for flights? no) | — | — |
| **Airline‑direct booking portals** | **Delta.com**, **United.com**, **AmericanAirlines.com**, **Southwest.com**, **AlaskaAir.com**, etc. | Direct booking, loyalty points | Book directly with airline |
| **API / SDK for developers** | **Amadeus for Developers** (Python, Java, Node) | Flight search, booking, availability, pricing | Build custom travel apps |
| | **Skyscanner API** (Python SDK) | Search, price alerts, flight details | Integrate flight search into your site |
| | **Kiwi.com API** (Python SDK) | Multi‑city itineraries, “no‑stop” search | Build complex itineraries |
| | **Travelport API** (Java, .NET) | Global distribution system (GDS) access | Enterprise travel solutions |
| | **Sabre API** (Java, .NET) | GDS, booking, inventory | Large‑scale travel agencies |
| | **FlightAware API** | Flight status, real‑time tracking | Add flight status to your app |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data | Aviation data analytics |
| | **Google Flights API** (unofficial) | Price trends, flight data | Research flight pricing |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, delays, historical data | Reliability analytics |
| | **AirLabs API** | Flight search, airline data | Build flight search features |
| | **FlightRadar24 API** (unofficial) | Live flight tracking | Real‑time flight info |
| **Travel aggregator APIs** | **Travelpayouts** | Affiliate flight booking, price comparison | Monetize flight search |
| | **Skiplagged API** | Hidden‑city fare search | Find cheaper routes |
| | **CheapTickets API** | Discounted fares, package deals | Low‑cost travel |
| **Other tools** | **FlightAware Flight Status** (web & mobile) | Check flight status | Quick status check |
| | **FlightRadar24** (app & web) | Live flight tracking | Monitor flights |
| | **FlightStats** (app & web) | Flight status, delays | Real‑time updates |

### How to choose

| Need | Recommended tool |
|------|-----------------|
| **Quick price comparison** | Skyscanner, Kayak, Momondo |
| **Lowest fare for a specific airline** | Airline’s own website |
| **Build a custom booking app** | Amadeus, Skyscanner, Kiwi.com |
| **Enterprise travel agency** | Sabre, Travelport |
| **Real‑time flight status** | FlightAware, FlightRadar24 |
| **Affiliate marketing** | Travelpayouts, Skiplagged |

Feel free to let me know if you need deeper details on any of these tools—API documentation links, pricing, or how to integrate them into a project!
